metadata.name: levermeme
metadata.description: LeverMeme guarded capped leverage, creator revenue and atomic buyback burns

instructions.name: cancel_listing
docs: The lister can reclaim both liquidity assets, even while paused.
The admission burn is irreversible. The tombstone prevents replay/relisting.

instructions.name: create_airdrop
docs: One funded supply-airdrop campaign per protocol, exactly 10% of the
immutable supply checkpoint captured at protocol initialization.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: Each administrator gets its own namespace. Clients pin the intended config
PDA; an attacker cannot initialize or replace someone else's namespace.

instructions.name: reclaim_airdrop
docs: Expired leftovers go only to the original administrator's token account.

instructions.name: request_listing
docs: All three effects are atomic: burn, meme-token escrow and SOL escrow.
Listing requests are not active derivative markets.

instructions.name: route_platform_revenue
docs: Distribute actual quote tokens owned by the operator. This does not
withdraw user collateral or claim that a derivative trade took place.

instructions.name: route_token_creator_revenue
docs: LeverMeme's own creator revenue, after collection/conversion to xSOL,
routes 50/50. A buyback allocation is not itself a swap or token burn.

instructions.name: set_listing_approved
docs: Admission approval is explicit. This does not activate derivative trading.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pausing stops new burns and deposits. Exits remain permissionless to owners.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: No administrator can redirect a user's collateral. There is no trading
instruction in this release; no margin can be locked or reallocated.
